details:
Sometimes I don't feel like using my microphone or thinking too much but get bombarded by "MARKVIEWS. STOP. AGE? WHAT IS YOUR AGE? I'M GOING TO KICK YOU" followed by being kicked shortly after joining group publics despite being age verified by vrchat, shown in on my profile.

I really think that vrchat should make manual "age verification" like this against the rules and allow us to report the group for doing so. It ruins the public world experience. These kids need to go moderate a subreddit not public vrchat worlds.

It's nice to be in a world with no screaming children, we can all agree on that but it's not nice to be forced to use my microphone or be kicked from a public instance..

I think that kicking someone for being a squeaker is fine but do so after you've heard them voluntarily speak, don't forge them to speak.

The current state of group publics makes me not want to play this game as 50% of the time I join one I'm kicked for not using my microphone. What about people who are playing vr next to a sleeping roommate? Actually unplayable, they just can't use group publics.. VRChat please add a rule banning this behavior.
title: Ban manual "age verification" in public instances
